scientific_integrity: Complete proof and separate original-definition exhaustive checks are included. No claim of prior uniqueness, certification, or independent mathematical auditing.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns ordinary inclusion-minimal forts of K_p Cartesian K_q for integers p,q at least two, not all forts or general line graphs. The minimum-fort cardinality four when a factor has order at least four is already implied by a 2015 failed-zero-forcing result; novelty is confined to exhaustive structural classification and all-size enumeration. Independent validation and exhaustive bibliographic priority verification are not performed.
title: Inclusion-minimal forts of rectangular rook graphs
